sources.snippet: Model developers Meta Variations Llama 3 comes in two sizes — 8B and 70B parameters — in pre-trained and instruction tuned variants. Input Models input text only. Output Models generate text and code only. Model Architecture Llama 3 is an auto-regressive language model that uses an optimized transformer architecture.

sources.title: [2407.21783] The Llama 3 Herd of Models - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: Modern artificial intelligence (AI) systems are powered by foundation models. This paper presents a new set of foundation models, called Llama 3. It is a herd of language models that natively support multilinguality, coding, reasoning, and tool usage.
